overview.about: The Sony Open in Hawaii is the PGA Tour's first full-field event of the year, played at the tight, tree-lined Waialae Country Club in Honolulu right after the season-opening Sentry. Trade winds and small greens on the classic Seth Raynor design make accuracy essential.
overview.nextEvent: The next Sony Open in Hawaii is played at Waialae Country Club in Honolulu, closing the Tour's short Hawaiian swing. Low scoring is the norm on the short but demanding par 70.
